lede: Winter Springs celebrates Christmas with a Winter Wonderland parade and tree lighting at Central Winds Park, a drive-through light display and a police Santa Run.
celebrates: The City of Winter Springs holds its annual Winter Wonderland at Central Winds Park, with a Holiday Parade, the Christmas tree lighting around sunset, live entertainment, food trucks and a visit from Santa. The park's lights then open to cars as Light Up Central Winds for six nights. The police department rounds out the season with a Santa Run through neighborhoods on two days.
